Considering a dental check-up while traveling abroad?

Seoul Today Dental Clinic in Goyang offers a comprehensive exam, digital X‑rays and a 3D CT scan.
An English‑speaking coordinator assists international patients throughout the visit.
The clinic is conveniently located near Samsong Station (Subway Line 3) and Starfield Goyang.

Read the full guide for more details.
